bull.t: Rapid revenue growth and improving adjusted profitability
bull.b: Exceptional revenue expansion alongside a swing to positive adjusted EBITDA indicates strong customer adoption and operating leverage in the AI cloud platform. If sustained, this scale can support reinvestment, improve unit economics, and strengthen Nebius’s competitive position over the next several quarters.

A substantial contracted backlog improves medium-term revenue visibility, while upfront customer funding helps support infrastructure deployment and liquidity. Together, these commitments provide commercial validation and reduce the need to finance all planned capacity solely through internal cash generation.

bull.t: AI platform efficiency and strategic distribution expansion
bull.b: Inference optimization can improve GPU utilization and customer token economics, making Nebius’s infrastructure more efficient as workloads scale. The separate sovereign AI partnership broadens enterprise distribution and reinforces the company’s positioning in security-sensitive, production AI deployments.

bear.t: Very high capital intensity and negative free cash flow
bear.b: The aggressive infrastructure build requires exceptionally large cash outlays before newly deployed capacity fully contributes to revenue. Deeply negative free cash flow increases dependence on external financing and creates execution risk if deployment, customer onboarding, or utilization falls behind plan.

Positive net income does not yet demonstrate durable operating earnings because core EBIT and EBITDA remain deeply negative. Continued operating losses can limit internally funded growth, make results more dependent on non-operating items, and leave profitability vulnerable during the expansion phase.

bear.t: Higher leverage and potential equity dilution
bear.b: A larger debt burden reduces financial flexibility while the scale of new convertible and equity financing increases future repayment and dilution exposure. These funding tools support expansion, but they also raise the capital base that must be serviced or converted as Nebius pursues its capacity targets.
